text:
mira: Heads-up — I'm opening a batch of docs PRs to move the 'getting-started' content into the new /quickstart layout. This will be 5 PRs (shard A..E). Need reviewer assignments and a merge order to avoid broken redirects and anchor drift.

alex: cool. can we gate merges behind the docs preview? last time anchors went missing because PR B merged before A. :grimacing:

jen: please list the exact PR order and which redirects each PR adds. I can volunteer to review the redirects and link-checks. :+1:

mira: plan draft: PRs: #8243 (shard-A: intro + auth), #8247 (shard-B: sdk snippets), #8251 (shard-C: API reference split), #8256 (shard-D: migration guide), #8260 (shard-E: redirects + anchor-mappings). Merge order 8243 -> 8247 -> 8251 -> 8256 -> 8260. Each PR contains a small redirects file; final PR consolidates anchor map.

sam: is there a CI preview for each PR? we should ensure previews include the redirect proxy so link checks run.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #8243. Preview URL: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-8243/docs — status: running.

tom: pinging @alex and @jen — can you be reviewers on the first two? I'll take #8256 (redirects).

alex: I'll review #8243 and #8247 but prefer merges during the weekday morning window (14:00-17:00 UTC) so infra support is available.

jen: I can do a quick pass on redirects and anchors for any PR during that window. assign me when ready.

mira: noted. CI note: the preview build for #8243 currently fails anchor-checker with `Broken anchor: #auth-flow` in the old sidebar include. I need to patch the include in #8243 before merge.

sam: can we add a lightweight smoke test to validate old->new redirect chains? I can add a script `tools/check-redirects.sh` and run in CI.

mira: yes please — add it to the docs-preview job and flag as non-blocking (warning) for now. we'll flip to blocking after PR #8260 merges.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build failed for PR #8243. Error: link-checker found 1 broken anchor. Logs: ```[link-checker] Broken anchor: /getting-started/auth.md#auth-flow referenced from /_includes/intro.md```

mira: fixing now — updating include path and adding the missing anchor in the new quickstart. Will push a tiny commit to #8243 in a minute.

alex: once #8243 preview is green, I'll queue it for merge during Monday 15:00 UTC. Keep me posted if more fixes land. :eyes:

jen: small request — when you update SDK snippets, please keep old examples in a collapsible note for one release. saves customers.

mira: good call. I'll add a `:::note` block with legacy examples in #8247.

docs-bot: reminder: use `/rerun-docs-preview` in the PR thread to re-trigger preview after force-pushes.

mira: thanks. I'll push fix and trigger preview. When #8243 is green, the rest of the sequence should be lower risk. I'll also open a short README in each shard describing its redirect responsibility so reviewers can quickly validate.

sam: sounds good. I'll prep `tools/check-redirects.sh` and open a tiny PR to add it to the preview job today.

alex: looking forward — ping me in the PR when preview is green. I'll do the merges in the order you outlined and hold on #8260 until everyone confirms anchor map. :shipit:

mira: awesome — thanks all. I'll drop the PR links here once they're up.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #8243 (rerun). Preview URL: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-8243/docs — status: running.
